mood: quiet warm-neutral white wall and table under one large left diffused window

reference_cluster.selection_rule: single product, top-heavy white negative space, low wall-table boundary and no direct sun patch

key_light.source: one very large side window diffused by an overcast sky or thin curtain
key_light.direction: left to right with a low-density rightward shadow
key_light.relative_size: very large, producing broad highlights and soft attached shadows

ambient_fill: weak neutral room bounce below the key; preserve local contact and glass edge modeling

shadow_contract.attachment: small contact occlusion at the base plus one broad low-density rightward cast shadow
shadow_contract.transparent_material: glass retains a faint connected transmitted lift and background-dependent refraction

contact_shadow.behavior: small denser attachment directly beneath the product base

cast_shadow.behavior: broad soft rightward falloff without a graphic silhouette

transmitted_light.behavior: faint beverage-colored lift only inside a physically connected transparent shadow

capture_contract.hdr: restrained social-photo HDR with protected white detail and no halo
capture_contract.white_balance: warm-neutral white with quiet neutral-to-cool shadows
capture_contract.texture: subtle wall and table irregularity, readable product detail and faint luminance grain

forbidden: direct sunbeam or bright graphic light patch

reference_anchor.role: offline camera, composition, white-surface and diffuse-light measurement authority

camera_coupling.support_plane: one matte white tabletop below a low wall-table boundary in a 50-60mm normal perspective
camera_coupling.shadow_projection: product highlights, base contact and the soft rightward table shadow agree with the same left window
camera_coupling.depth_response: product scale, support-plane edge and gentle tonal falloff establish depth without portrait blur

color_separation.shadow_neutral: quiet neutral to faintly cool gray
color_separation.material_locality: the user product keeps source-authoritative local color while wall and table remain low-saturation neutrals
